correctness.rationale: For b=2a+1 and generators b+2t with 0<=t<=a or a+1, an h-summand representation of qb+2s forces parity h≡q mod 2 and h<=q. Exact two-, three-, four- and five-part partition bounds give a residue-by-residue first crossing by q<=5 for all admissible a>=4,p<=floor((a+1)/2). Pair counts differ by one precisely at two terminal residues, except the odd-a maximal-p endpoint; p=0 and p=1 special cases give one and four shifted integers, respectively. Independent integer DP checked all thresholds for a=4..24 over n<=25a, as well as p=0,1 genus formulas. The all-integer result follows from the q-monotonic injection and cited Gaussian unimodality, not the finite check.
residual_risks: No classification for p>floor((a+1)/2) or arbitrary progressions.

The general p-Apéry/genus identity and older arithmetic-progression results give tools, not these precise all-parameter finite transfer sets.
